translation.title: Terbinafine Dermgel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes - tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea cruris (jock itch) and tinea corporis (ringworm of the body) - and for pityriasis versicolor.
translation.usage: Before applying, wash the affected area clean and dry it, then apply a thin layer to the infected area and its surroundings once a day. For infections in skin folds (under the breasts, between the fingers or toes, between the buttocks, in the groin), the area may be covered with gauze at night. Symptoms usually start to ease within 2 to 3 days, and the usual treatment period is one week.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or for children. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it on the face or around the eyes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them thoroughly under running water. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have skin lesions that may be irritated by alcohol. Adverse reactions such as hives, redness, erythema (red patches), itching or irritation may appear at the application site. Store below 30 degrees Celsius.
